about: The fixed sabotage catalogue of PRV-03, replayed offline on fresh copies with the gate a repository pins. Corpus example: the mission the gate under test scaffolds (init --example), sabotaged in fixed ways, checked with check --strict unsealed (N) and after sealing the pristine mission (S). Corpus mission: generic sabotages chosen deterministically from the repository's own typed pointers. expect is the specification (what a sound gate does); expected.json holds what each gate version did when the catalogue was frozen. Cases T00 to T13 are those of the 2026-11-05 audit; T14 and T15 were added with grille@1.

expectations.refuse: the gate must exit non-zero: caught (exit 1), missed (exit 0), error (anything else)
expectations.pass: the gate must stay green: green (exit 0), false-red (exit 1), error
expectations.invariant: two honest runs that differ only by something outside the mission's meaning must give the same green verdict: invariant, divergent (the exits differ), false-red (both refuse), error
